name: TE Connectivity plc
blurb: TE Connectivity is one of the world's largest manufacturers of electrical connectors, sensors, and related components, serving transportation, industrial, energy, and data-communications markets. Often invisible to the end consumer, its products appear wherever electricity or data must cross a physical boundary reliably — from the high-voltage harness inside an electric vehicle to the subsea cable splice deep on the ocean floor.
recent: In February 2025 TE announced the acquisition of Richards Manufacturing, a maker of overhead and underground electrical distribution hardware, for approximately $2.3 billion — signalling an expansion into grid infrastructure beyond its traditional connector product lines. The company has also been investing in 800V and 1000V EV connector architectures, where content-per-vehicle is estimated to run roughly 30% above internal-combustion equivalents. A presence at DISTRIBUTECH 2026 underscores its grid-modernisation push.

sources.title: TE Connectivity acquires EV charging inlet business from Phoenix Contact
